name: company-ids-table-to-fivetran-sheet

deploy.description: Weekly full refresh of the 'Company IDs' tab of the Fivetran Sync Jobs spreadsheet from [Table] Company IDs. Source of truth: https://github.com/work-flowers/zapier-sdk/tree/main/company-ids-table-to-fivetran-sheet
deploy.enable_on_publish_note: Parked at first publish so it cannot race the still-live classic Zap on the same tab. Cutover: disable the classic 'Refresh Company IDs Table in Fivetran Sheet', then `zapier-sdk --experimental enable-workflow <workflow_id>`.

trigger.trigger_note: Schedule by Zapier, Sundays at 12:00 AM, same as the classic Zap. `dow` is ARRAY and `hod` STRING per `list-trigger-input-fields`. No `timezone_override`: the account timezone is already Asia/Singapore, which is what the classic Zap ran on. No connection and no external URL.

google_sheets.note: The workflow addresses the tab by TITLE, not gid: the Sheets values API only takes A1 notation. Renaming the tab breaks this workflow — and Fivetran's own config — so the title is a contract. Columns A-L must stay in the header order recorded in COLUMNS in workflow.ts; Fivetran keys on column A (tables_record_id).
google_sheets.api_route: GoogleSheetsV2CLIAPI write `_zap_raw_request` (API Request (Beta)) against sheets.googleapis.com, so the calls keep the connection's auth and Zapier's audit trail. Two calls per run: values:clear on 'Company IDs'!A2:L, then values:append on 'Company IDs'!A1.

tables.01JM8PH8YM93A482M8BFZ6WKW6: [Table] Company IDs — READ ONLY here (every row whose f14 Notion Page ID is set, the classic Zap's filter). Owned by notion-companies-to-zapier-table. Table reads consume no Zapier tasks.

replaces_classic_zap: Refresh Company IDs Table in Fivetran Sheet

cutover.status: pending — durable is published but DISABLED. Enable it in the same sitting as disabling the classic Zap.

behaviour_changes: The classic Zap deleted rows 2..(N+1) where N was the count of the NEW data, then appended. When the Table shrank it left orphan rows behind; when it grew it deleted rows it was about to rewrite anyway. The durable clears A2:L outright and appends the full set, so the tab always matches the Table.
`values:append` grows the grid when the Table has outgrown the sheet; the classic Zap's row-add path did not, and a plain values.update would reject the write.
An empty Table read now ABORTS the run instead of clearing the tab: the mirror is never legitimately empty, so a read failure must not blank Fivetran's source.
Reading the Table is free (Tables API), so the run costs 2 Zapier tasks instead of the classic Zap's 4 steps.
description: Schedule trigger (Sundays 00:00 Asia/Singapore) -> clear and rewrite the 'Company IDs' tab of the Fivetran Sync Jobs spreadsheet from every row of [Table] Company IDs.
